subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supply Chain Due Diligence Laws
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Supply Chain Due Diligence Laws.

hook.text: Germany's Supply Chain Act fines firms up to 2% of revenue for human rights or environmental violations by suppliers.

buildup.text: Due diligence laws require companies to identify, prevent, and mitigate harm in their supply chains.

discovery.text: They cover child labor, forced labor, environmental damage, and unsafe working conditions at supplier sites.

twist.text: Companies must monitor Tier 1 and act on Tier 2+ issues when they become aware. Ignorance is no longer a defense.

climax.text: The EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive will extend these rules across all member states.

punchline.text: What your supplier does is now legally your responsibility.

quiz.question: What do supply chain due diligence laws require?
options: Identifying and preventing human rights and environmental harm
